rules.examples: upright, level, flat, tilt, spill, steady, balanced
rules.effect: observes whether the object's up axis stays aligned with the world's up axis

rules.phrasing: \blook|watch|gaze|point (at|the camera)|face the|observ|in view|an eye on|focus on|keep sight|see the|where it (operat|work)
rules.examples: look, watch, observe, keep in view, gaze, face the
rules.effect: the transport looks at the object before picking it up and at the target before placing it

rules.examples: above, higher, off the table, keep high, lift
rules.sentence: Keep the bowl 5 cm above the table
rules.effect: observes whether the object stays above a height; a length in the sentence sets it

rules.examples: below, under, lower than, keep low
rules.effect: observes whether the object stays below a height; a length in the sentence sets it

rules.examples: away from, keep clear of, clearance, avoid, don't touch
rules.sentence: Keep the milk 10 cm away from the bowl
rules.effect: observes whether the object keeps a distance from a second object the sentence names; a length sets it
